items.title: Celebrities and Famous People in the Turks and Caicos | Visit Turks and Caicos Islands
items.summary:
Date: 1928

Prince George, Duke of Kent, visited Grand Turk aboard the Royal Navy D-Class Light Cruiser HMS Durban during a relief mission after the major 1928 Hurricane (referred to as the Hurricane of the Century). He went ashore incognito.

Princess Margaret

Date: 1960

Princess Margaret Rose of the United Kingdom, Countess of Snowdon, paid an official visit to Grand Turk on the HMS Britannia. On the visit, she stopped at the two US bases on the island: NAVFAC and South Base.

© NASA [...] Date: 1966

Queen Elizabeth II visited South Caicos in 1966 aboard the HMS Royal Britannia. To commemorate the visit, the South Caicos Regatta has been held ever since.

© Allan Warren / CC BY-SA 3.0

Duke of Edinburgh

Date: 1966

Prince Philip, the Duke of Edinburgh, accompanied Queen Elizabeth II on her visit to South Caicos. The royal couple observed donkey races and sloop sailing, activities held in honor of their visit aboard the Royal Britannia.

© Arnaud Bouissou

King Charles III [...] King Charles III

Date: 1973

King Charles III (then Prince Charles) stopped over at Grand Turk on the HMS  Minerva. During his stay, he took part in local cricket matches as a member of the ship’s team. The ship’s crew also conducted community service and took the island’s Series Land Rover ambulance to the local hospital to repair and paint.

© Northern Ireland Office / CC BY 2.0

Andrew Mountbatten Windsor

Date: 2000
